name: ai-api-unified-http
description: HTTP interface to the ai-api-unified Python library. Deploys into your own Google Cloud project, using your own provider keys.

HTTP_API_KEYS.description: Comma-separated API keys callers present as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Each entry is label:key. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic key, for the 'claude' engine. Leave blank if unused.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI key, for the 'openai' engine. Leave blank if unused.

GOOGLE_GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini key, for the 'google-gemini' engine. Leave blank if unused.

COMPLETIONS_ENGINE.description: Default completions engine when a request omits one.

COMPLETIONS_FALLBACKS.description: Optional. Ordered engine:model pairs a request is retried on when its model is overloaded, rate limited, or out of quota, e.g. 'openai:gpt-5.6-luna,google-gemini'. Each needs its provider key above. Leave blank for no fallback.

HTTP_RATE_LIMIT.description: Requests per key per window, per worker. Guards provider spend. 0 disables it.

HTTP_CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call this service.
